style.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust screens, soft blue-grey #EEF1F6 for benefit, comparison and closing screens, graphite #25272C reserved for the pain strip and the specification block

noDrift: no brand logos or model codes on the product
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set; all frame tubes, upright columns and deck edges perfectly straight; every screen surface kept neutral and unreadable
